headline: Starwood Capital and Trez Capital Form US Residential Land Venture
summary: Starwood Capital and Trez Capital announced the formation of a joint venture focused on providing US residential land loans.
why: Real estate private equity joint ventures mobilize institutional capital for residential development financing and credit markets.

impacts.name: Real Estate Finance
impacts.why: New lending joint venture increases capital availability for residential land development.
